overview_description.description: EliseAI provides artificial intelligence–powered automation and conversational services designed for housing and healthcare organizations. It offers a unified platform that manages communications across text, email, chat, and voice, handling tasks such as leasing inquiries, tenant maintenance requests, scheduling, renewals, and patient appointments. The system centralizes operations into modules like CRM, leasing, maintenance, delinquency handling, and healthcare-specific workflows, adapting to specialties such as women’s health, dermatology, ophthalmology, and orthopedics. It automates routine interactions, status updates, and follow-ups in multiple languages, aiming to reduce manual burden and streamline operational workflows.

about_short_description.short_description: EliseAI is an AI-driven company that offers automation, streamlining workflows, and unique needs of housing and healthcare operations.

product.name: EliseAI Property Management Platform
product.description: An AI platform for automating leasing, resident communications, and property-management workflows across multifamily, single-family, student, and affordable housing portfolios.

product.name: EliseCRM
product.description: A centralized CRM for managing prospect and resident conversations, tasks, scheduling, routing, and portfolio-level operational insights.

product.name: LeasingAI
product.description: AI automation for prospect engagement, lead nurturing, tour scheduling, and conversion throughout the housing leasing process.

product.name: ResidentAI
product.description: AI automation for resident operations, including move-ins, maintenance, renewals, payment-related communication, and delinquency management.

product.name: EliseAI Healthcare Platform
product.description: An AI platform that automates patient communication, appointment scheduling, reminders, intake, and administrative workflows for healthcare practices.

product.name: VoiceAI
product.description: An AI voice assistant for handling inbound and outbound calls, answering questions, scheduling interactions, and supporting housing and healthcare operations 24/7.
